messages:
Aisha (eng-platform): quick sync — thinking about 'permission priming' when routing policies change. e.g. tenant flips from hosted->dedicated and we need to show what roles/scopes will be affected and how quota attribution moves. thoughts?
Ben (product): love the name. concrete ask from PMs: show per-route effective quota burn and the fallback policy if the new tier has strict entitlements. they want a small inline preview, not a modal. :eyes:
Carol (eng-security): big +1 but we need to be explicit about scope elevation during canary rollouts. if a route gains a scope temporarily (for testing), audit log and TTL required. also need an API for simulation.
Sam (devex): suggestion: add a 'simulate request as' UX button that calls internal API to evaluate effective permissions. prototype call:
```
POST /internal/v1/tenants/123/simulate
{ "route": "/api/generate", "principal": "service:billing", "timestamp": 1680000000 }
// returns effective roles/scopes + quota buckets
```
Priya (sre): telemetry note — if we route to fallback model we should tag telemetry with route_policy=safe_fallback so cost/latency dashboards can filter. otherwise we lose signal for why quotas spiked.
Aisha (eng-platform): agree on tagging. also UX detail: when the preview shows 'effective quota', show both current and post-rollout estimates (e.g., tokens/month). small sparkline would help.
Ben (product): wondering about layout: inline preview under route row vs dedicated 'Permissions preview' pane. inline keeps context but could be noisy for large tenants. maybe collapsible rows with a telemetry summary row.
Carol (eng-security): API contract we need: GET /v1/tenants/:tid/effective-roles?route=...&preview_policy=canaryId -> returns list of roles, scopes, quotaBuckets and warnings. include fields: 
```
[ { "role": "route-admin", "scopes": ["invoke","view-usage"], "quota": {"limit": 100000, "period": "month"}, "warnings": ["elevated-scope-ttl:24h"] } ]
```
Sam (devex): small UX caveat: when showing warnings, inline 'why' link should jump to audit entries or the policy diff. product asked for a one-click 'open diff' that shows what changed in JSON.
Priya (sre): rollout automation: deploy-bot should emit events when routing policy flips for a tenant. e.g.,
deploy-bot: Canary started tenant=123 policy=route_affinity_v2 -> we can use that to trigger permission re-evals.
Aisha (eng-platform): good — we'll add a permission-refresh hook that listens to deploy-bot events and marks cached effective-roles stale. also add a conservative fallback: if simulation fails, default to showing current effective roles and a red banner 'preview unavailable'.
Ben (product): accessibility note — collapsible previews must work with keyboard nav and screen readers. Sam can you prototype keyboard flow?
Sam (devex): yup, will mock. also will include copyable curl + JSON so support can repro permission sims.
Carol (eng-security): one last: make TTLs machine-readable in UI (e.g., 24h -> expiration timestamp) so auditors can export a CSV with exact expiry.
Aisha (eng-platform): plan: I'll sketch API spec + UX wire by EOD, Sam start prototype, Carol we'll loop in on API contract. Priya will wire telemetry tags. tagging here: :+1:
